headline: Public hearings on an accessory dwelling unit at 48 Essex Street and a child care facility at 200 Exchange Street.
summary: The committee will hold public hearings on a proposed accessory dwelling unit at 48 Essex Street and a proposed KinderCare Education child care facility at 200 Exchange Street. It will also review September minutes and discuss other business.
items: Site Plan Review for Accessory Dwelling Unit at 48 Essex Street (Parcel ID 083 402 224), Permit Application #RES-078067-2026, to build an Accessory Dwelling Unit in the existing two-story detached garage, accessory to the existing two-family dwelling

Site Plan Review for Educational, Religious and/or Child Care Facility Uses at 200 Exchange Street (Parcel ID 051 278 801), Permit Application #CMID078749-2026, to occupy the existing building for an education childcare facility (KinderCare Education)
Other business properly before the Committee
location: Mayor's Conference Room, 4th Floor, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA

Page 1 of 1 
 
CITY of MALDEN 
SITE PLAN REVIEW COMMITTEE 
 
 
 
AGENDA 
 October 27, 2026 at 6:00 pm 
Mayor’s Conference Room, 4th Floor  
Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 
  
I. Call to Order. 
II. Roll Call. 
 
III. PUBLIC HEARINGS. (Order of hearings to be determined by Chairperson) 
A. Site Plan Review for Accessory Dwelling Units 
Title 12, Code of City of Malden, Section 12.32.030.D. 
1) 48 Essex Street (Parcel ID 083 402 224)/Permit Application #RES-078067-
2026/To construct in the existing two-story detached garage building an 
Accessory Dwelling Unit, accessory to the existing two-family dwelling. 
 
B. Site Plan Review for Educational, Religious and/or Child Care Facility Uses 
Title 12, Code of City of Malden, Section 12.12.500. 
1) 200 Exchange Street (Parcel ID 051 278 801)/Permit Application #CMID-
078749-2026 /To occupy building for education childcare facility in the existing 
building. 
 
IV. PUBLIC MEETING. (Order of items to be determined by Chairperson)  
A. Minutes – Review and approve for meetings 
• September 22, 2026 
B. Other business properly before Committee.   
C. Next meeting scheduled: November 24, 2026. 
 
V. Adjournment. 
 
 
Petitions and plans available for public review on City website https://maldenma-
energovweb.tylerhost.net/apps/SelfService#/home. “Search Public Records”- use Permit Application #, view 
Attachments. 
 
To request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance  Coordinator at 
mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000, Ext 2005.
MALDEN SITE PLAN REVIEW COMMITTEE  
for ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS  
 
PUBLIC HEARING 
 
 
The Malden Site Plan Review Committee for Accessory Dwelling Units will 
hold a public hearing in Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, 
Mayor’s Conference Room, 4th Floor, at 6:00 P.M. on Tuesday, October 27, 
2026, on the petition of Pablo Cesar Crisanto, filed in Permit Application #RES-
078067-2026 under Title 12, Code of the City of Malden, Section 12.32.030.D, 
seeking Site Plan Review and Site Plan Approval of a proposed Accessory 
Dwelling Unit to be constructed in the existing two-story detached garage 
building, accessory to the existing two-family dwelling, at the property known as 
and numbered, 48 Essex St., Malden, MA, and by City Assessor’s Parcel 
Identification #083 402 224.  Petition and plans are available for public review in 
the Inspectional Services Department, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, 
Room 330, Malden, MA and through the City website under Permit Application # 
RES-078067-2026 at https://maldenma-
energovweb.tylerhost.net/apps/SelfService#/home 
 
By: Nelson Miller 
  Chair, Site Plan Review Committee
